evidence: To characterize material quality several types of structures were produced. For PL measurements, DHs and QWs with ALE- or LALE-grown GaAs sandwiched between MOCVD Ale3Gae,As cladding layers were formed. Capacitance-voltage (C-V) measurements with a Schottky junction formed by a Au or Ag dot used similar DHs as well as samples with a thick (0.5 pm) top GaAs layer grown by LALE. For secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) profiling, multiple layer DHs with each -700 A thick GaAs layer using a different combination of precursors were produced.
